markdownReply.description: Send a markdown (or plain text) message into an existing conversation.

reply.markdown: **Report ready.** Your weekly summary is attached.

replyWithFile.description: Attach files to a markdown reply. Provide exactly one of `url` or `data` per file. Prefer `url` for larger files.

cardReply.description: Send a Chat SDK card (buttons, text, links). Build cards with `@novu/framework` helpers or an equivalent JSON tree.

children.content: Your order is ready for pickup.

editMessage.description: Update a previously delivered agent message in place. Cannot be combined with resolve, signals, or reactions.

content.markdown: Updated: the report is now final.

typingStart.description: Best-effort status text on platforms that support it. Omit `status` for the default "Thinking…".

typingStop.description: Clear the typing / status indicator for this turn.

addReaction.description: React to a platform message with a well-known emoji name.

deleteMessage.description: Remove a previously posted platform message. Conversation history is preserved.

resolveConversation.description: Mark the conversation resolved. Optionally include a summary and/or a final reply in the same request.

reply.markdown: Glad that helped — marking this as resolved.

resolve.summary: Answered billing question about invoice INV-42.

metadataSignal.description: Persist key/value metadata on the conversation for later turns. Keys: 1–128 chars, letters/digits with `-`, `_`, `:` separators.

humanApprove.summary: Ask the conversation subscriber to approve
humanApprove.description: Create an approve/deny card in the current conversation thread. The verdict arrives later on `onAction` with `ctx.humanResponse`.

triggerWorkflow.description: Fire a workflow from the agent turn. When `to` is omitted, Novu uses the conversation subscriber if one is resolved.

toolResult.description: Persist tool-call outcomes into conversation history (typically before the assistant reply).

reply.markdown: Your order **ORD-42** has shipped and should arrive by July 16.

toolApprovalRequest.description: Ledger a gated tool call and optionally deliver an approval card via `reply.toolApprovalCard` or a normal card/markdown reply.

turnError.description: Bridge reports that the customer runtime failed. Cannot be combined with other actions. Novu delivers generic user-facing copy.
